name: Castellax-Achea Automata
equipped_with: Every model is equipped with: Asphyx heavy bolter; Asphyx combi-bolter; Pair of force claws.

weapons.name: Pair of force claws
weapons.abilities: Extra Attack(2), Force weapon, Shred, Unwieldy

option_groups.header: Every Castellax-Achea may swap their Asphyx heavy bolter with

abilities: Aegis(4+), Fearless, Thousand Sons Legion, Unyielding, Ward(5+)
Psi-locus: Any Thousand Sons Psyker within 12" who suffers Perils of the Warp may choose to inflict the effect on this unit before rolling on the Perils of the Warp Table.

Psychic Conduit: When a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker within 12" casts a Witchfire or Malediction power, it may measure the range and the line of sight from this model instead. Additionally, if a Thousand Sons psyker within 12" successfully manifests a spell, this unit counts as successfully manifesting a spell for the purposes of the "Force weapon" ability.

Psychometric Control: If this model is not within 18" of a Thousand Sons Character with the Psyker ability, it can only be assigned "Fight" or "Stand & Shoot" Orders, and must fire all its ranged weapons at the nearest enemy unit.
